tokens.name: brand-coral
tokens.usage: Brand coral from the guidelines. Large fills, illustration, the logo's 'tom'. Never body text on white (2.9:1); text on it uses `ink`.

tokens.name: brand-mint
tokens.usage: Brand mint. Fills, chips and illustration. Text on it uses `ink`; never white text on mint.

tokens.name: brand-sunflower
tokens.usage: Brand sunflower. The 'Create' highlight and celebratory accents. Text on it uses `ink` (10:1).

tokens.name: brand-brown
tokens.usage: Brand book brown, from the logo's book spine. Illustration and decorative marks only.

tokens.name: brand-brown-deep
tokens.usage: Brand book brown, shadow tone. Illustration only.

tokens.name: brand-grey
tokens.usage: Brand grey. The light page background (`surface-page`).

tokens.name: hero-start
tokens.usage: Hero gradient start (linear 90°, to `hero-end`). App icon, splash and marketing only; never behind text.

tokens.name: hero-end
tokens.usage: Hero gradient end.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background behind screens.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs and the tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Image wells, skeletons and the pressed state of list rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface-page`, `surface-card` and every brand fill (coral, mint, sunflower in light; mint and sunflower in dark). 15:1 on page.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, helper text, metadata. 5.9:1 light, 7.9:1 dark on `surface-page`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and card edges. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input and outline-button borders. 3:1 or more on `surface-card` in both themes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (one per screen). Coral, deepened in light so white text passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed state.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, selected tab label and icon, text buttons. Mint deepened in light for 4.7:1 on `surface-page`.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Secondary emphasis fills: selected chips, progress, toggles on.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `accent-fill`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The 'Create' action and favourite stars.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on `highlight`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element; 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons. Always with an icon and a word; never confused with brand coral, which is never used for errors.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Error banner background; text on it uses `danger`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons, with a word.

tokens.name: success-surface
tokens.usage: Success banner background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons, with a word.

tokens.name: warning-surface
tokens.usage: Warning banner background (e.g. 'Story awaiting approval').

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: screen titles and empty-state headlines.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running UI text. Never smaller for anything a parent must read.
styles.sample: Stories are ready in about 10 minutes.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels and emphasis inside body text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and chip labels, sparingly.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and between stacked labels and fields.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of screen to title; around empty states.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target size (also used as button height).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners) and modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tab indicator, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on `surface-page`.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the tab bar edge.
